data.long_description:
Welcome to Aqasa Enqlave at Al Furjan, a distinguished residential project by Aqasa Developers, featuring premium studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. This new addition to the skyline represents a fusion of innovation and timeless elegance, setting a new standard for luxury urban living.

The 12-storey building showcases a sleek and modern design, with attention to every detail, from the grand entrance to the sophisticated interior finishes. Each element has been thoughtfully crafted to deliver an exceptional living experience.

Highlights of the amenities include:

Children's Play Area
Elevators
Expansive living and dining spaces
Community Centre
